content.comment_body: Is anyone able to explain how to add an expansion module in the network view? I want to have five [product_name] controllers send data to another [product_name] controller, and I require ten inputs. When I try to combine everything using [product_name] engineering software, it keeps telling me I'm out of available inputs. The [product_name] controller I'm using does have a [product_name] module providing extra inputs.

In the network view, specifying expansion modules is not possible—only controllers, operator devices, or [version_no]-compatible hardware can be added. This is a [product_name] setup, not an [version_no] setup, so it operates differently from the hardware manager found in [version_no].

The [product_name] controller is capable of handling up to 24 digital inputs and 64 inputs from the network. If possible, please share a screenshot of the error and upload your program for troubleshooting.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing difficulties adding expansion modules in the network view of [product_name] engineering software. They assume expansion modules can be specified and configured within the network view but are running into input limitations. Users perceive a gap between their expectations for hardware expansion and how the software interface actually works when setting up input configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the ability to directly add and set up expansion modules in the network view of [product_name] engineering software to increase the total number of inputs for their project.
